hero.title: A Jacquard loom lifting warp ends
hero.desc: A Jacquard head above a punched card that presses on the needles. Where the card has holes, the hooks rise and the matching warp ends lift above the rest, drawn higher and in gold. Lifted warp ends: {lifted}. One weft thread passes under them.
hero.desc.plain: A Jacquard head above a punched card that presses on the needles, with the warp ends below at rest. No hook is raised and no warp end is lifted. One weft thread passes.
photo.loomHero.alt: A large old Jacquard loom standing in a museum hall. A tall dark wooden frame carries the Jacquard head on top, and rows of threads run down from it to the cloth below. Pale wooden beams slant across the glass wall behind.
photo.sariPatternCards.alt: Close-up of punched cards hanging at the right of a hand loom. Each card is a grey board with rows of round holes. On the left, many yellow threads run down from the loom.
photo.kanchipuramHandloom.alt: The wooden frame of a hand loom seen from below, in a whitewashed room. A long chain of punched cards hangs down on the right, and a bundle of yellow threads falls from the beam above. Green cords are tied to the beam.
photo.bradfordCardChain.alt: The top of a Jacquard loom in an old mill. A green iron Jacquard head takes in a long strip of punched cards that curves down through a metal trough, and a sheet of threads hangs from the head to the loom below.
photo.bradfordCardStack.alt: An old loom in a mill, lit by a long tube light. High on the left a bundle of punched cards hangs folded together. Below, a white cloth with a fine dark blue check lies on the loom.
art.cardDiamond.alt: One punch card of the Diamond sample on a cream table, seen from above. The card is tan board with square corners and a soft shadow. Rows of round holes are punched in a regular pattern, with a larger hole at the middle of each short side and a small hole near each top and bottom corner for the lacing.
art.cardBorder.alt: One punch card of the Border sample on a cream table, seen from above. Most of the tan board is plain. A few round holes are punched near the top and the bottom edge, with a larger hole at the middle of each short side and small lacing holes near the corners.
art.cardFloral.alt: One punch card of the Floral sample on a cream table, seen from above. Short rows of round holes are punched in groups across the tan board, with a larger hole at the middle of each short side and small lacing holes near the corners.
art.gridDiamond.alt: The Diamond sample drawn as a grid of small squares on a white panel. Dark green squares are the ends that lift, pale squares stay down. The dark squares make a ring and a filled centre, a diamond, repeated in three rows of four. Thin lines mark where one repeat ends and the next begins.
art.clothDiamond.alt: Woven cloth of the Diamond sample. Cream diamonds, each a ring round a filled centre, stand on a deep red ground in three rows of four.
art.clothBorder.alt: Woven cloth of the Border sample. A zigzag of deep red threads and a straight red line run down each edge. Between them the cloth is cream with fine gold lines across it.
art.clothFloral.alt: Woven cloth of the Floral sample. Cream flowers made of crossing bars stand on a deep green ground in three rows, with a thin gold line across the cloth after every few rows.
art.clothLost.alt: The Diamond cloth woven with three lost cards. Three thin bands of red and white cross-hatching cut across the rows of cream diamonds on a deep red ground, one for each card that is missing.
art.chain8.alt: Eight punch cards of the Diamond sample laced into a chain with red cords, laid out on a cream table in two rows of four. Two cords join each card to the next. At the right end of the rows two longer cords curve round and carry the chain back along the lower row.
credits.photos.heading: Photo credits
processLoop.title: A punch card being woven into cloth
processLoop.desc: A loop that repeats every seven seconds. A punch card slides into the Jacquard head and its holes light up. The hooks under the holes rise and lift their warp ends, a weft thread passes under them, and one more row of cloth appears. The cards follow one another, faster and faster, for {picks} picks, until the cloth is finished.
processLoop.desc.still: The finished cloth of {picks} picks, and the last punch card in the Jacquard head with its holes lit. The hooks under the holes are raised and lift their warp ends. Nothing moves.
landing.lead: Photograph a punched card. Naqsha reads its holes, shows the cloth they weave, and keeps the design for your loom.
landing.facts.name: Three facts about Naqsha
landing.fact.uploads.label: uploads: your photos stay on your device
landing.fact.offline.label: works with no network after the first visit
landing.fact.picks.label: picks in the Diamond sample
landing.samples.name: Sample designs
landing.how.heading: Three steps from card to cloth
landing.how.subtitle: Read the card, see the design, watch the cloth.
landing.how.card.title: Read the card
landing.how.card.text: Photograph a punched card and open the photo. Naqsha reads each hole: a hole lifts a thread, no hole leaves it down.
landing.how.pattern.title: See the design
landing.how.pattern.text: The cards together make the design, one row for each pick. A dark square is a thread that lifts, a pale square a thread that stays down.
landing.how.cloth.title: Watch the cloth
landing.how.cloth.text: The cloth weaves one pick at a time, as it will on the loom. Change the thread colours before you thread the loom.
landing.can.heading: Put your old cards to work
landing.can.subtitle: Everything runs on this device. No sign-up needed.
landing.can.read.title: Read a card
landing.can.read.text: Open a photo of a punched card and Naqsha finds each hole. Each card becomes one pick.
landing.can.weave.title: Weave a preview
landing.can.weave.text: Watch the cloth weave pick by pick before you thread the loom, and try other thread colours.
landing.can.export.title: Export a BMP
landing.can.export.text: Make a BMP file for an electronic loom: one square for each end, one row for each pick.
landing.can.keep.title: Keep versions
landing.can.keep.text: Save a design on this device. Save a change as a new version and the earlier design stays as it was.
landing.can.code.title: Code view
landing.can.code.text: See each card as one line of ones and zeros, and compare two designs to find the holes that changed.
landing.can.repair.title: Repair guesses
landing.can.repair.text: When a card is lost or damaged, Naqsha guesses what it looked like from the cards around it, and shows why. A guess is only a guess.
landing.can.offline.title: Works offline
landing.can.offline.text: After your first visit Naqsha needs no network. Your photos and designs stay on this device.
landing.try.heading: Weave a sample before you scan your own
landing.try.subtitle: Pick one and watch it weave, pick by pick.
landing.sample.diamond: Rings round filled centres: a diamond, repeated across the cloth.
landing.sample.border: A zigzag and a straight line down each edge, plain cloth between.
landing.sample.floral: Small flowers in rows, with a thin gold line every few rows.
landing.tile.try.name: Try it: {design}
landing.night.heading: Easy on the eyes after dark
landing.night.text: Working late? Night loom turns the page dark and keeps the words clear, so a card is easy to read under one lamp. Naqsha remembers your choice on this device.
landing.band.heading: Bring a card
landing.band.text: Photograph one punched card, or start with a sample. Naqsha shows you the cloth before you thread the loom.
landing.band.privacy: Your photos are read on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
landing.footer.line: Naqsha reads a loom's punch cards and weaves the design again, in your browser.
